column1: # Combat log + misc UI literals missed by the first pass. zh <TAB> en <TAB> [note]
# Source: main.js / display.js short string literals (see diag_combat.py).
# ␣ = a literal space. Chinese runs words together where English needs separators,
# and a real trailing space in a TSV is invisible and gets eaten by editors, so
# build.py substitutes ␣ -> " " on load. Applied as substrings (longest first),
# so " 伤害[暴击]" wins over " 伤害".
# --- damage / combat lines: "X 受到了 N 伤害[暴击]" ---

column3: 点 = counter word, dropped in English
NB: the v4.0 ['到','to'] pair mangles this to "回to" if it runs first
spec tag on "…点伤害[领域]". 领域 is typed `slot` in 00_morphemes so it is EXACT-only and cannot match inside a longer node; bracket-scoped keeps it off prose.
